voxel_statistics: sum_xyz, sum_rgb_u8, point_count; representative is per-voxel arithmetic mean
admission: assigned non-alias observations only; deferred observations excluded; raw evidence remains append-only
same_observation_idempotency: same ID and same payload hash is a no-op; same ID in another object or with a different payload is an error
causal_order: new observations for an object have nondecreasing timestamps; stale exact-payload replay is a no-op
pose_metric: unique_sensor_pose_count; fingerprint is full T_W_Copt rounded to 6 decimal places; this is pose uniqueness only, not independent-view evidence
geometry_repeat_policy: each distinct assigned observation contributes its selected points once, even when the pose repeats

resource_policy.overflow: fail the run before silently dropping evidence
